The problem

Before a supplier is paid, an auditor must review a bundle of documents for every payment.

Purchase order→Goods receipt→Invoice
0of pages per bundle
3-waymanual matching
Sampleinstead of full review

Small errors that sampling misses

  • VAT charged on an exempt item
  • Commission calculated on the wrong base
  • The same goods receipt paid twice
  • A late-delivery penalty never applied

Why full-population testing matters

📐

ISA 530 · Sampling risk

A conclusion drawn from a sample may differ from the conclusion on the whole population.

✅

ISA 500 · Testing all items

Testing 100% of items is acceptable when repetitive, automated checks make it cost-effective.

🏛️

Etimad & Vision 2030

Digital government procurement, spending efficiency and transparency.

Goal: move from checking a sample to checking every receipt, without losing reliability.

Research questions

Q1How can a hybrid pipeline separate reading documents from judging them?
Q2Can calculation rules be read from each contract and applied per item, even without the contract?
Q3How well can scanned documents be read, and what do prompts, preprocessing and fine-tuning add?
Q4How do we link receipts to orders and invoices, handle shared invoices and detect duplicates?
Q5How many errors pass without referral, and what does referral cost the reviewer?

The core principle

👁️

The model reads

  • Copies values exactly as printed
  • Returns null when a field is not visible
  • Never calculates, never decides
⇄
⚖️

The engine decides

  • Exact Decimal arithmetic
  • Rules read from each contract
  • Refers what it cannot prove

Reading errors are caught by a deterministic gate or by cross-document matching, so they never reach the verdict.

Pick the contract's VAT rule

Same receipt, five different correct answers. Only the contract text decides which one applies.

Reading scanned pages: what made the difference

90 synthetic scanned pages from tenders not used for tuning. Prompt design and preprocessing beat extra training.

The verification gate

Deterministic checks on every page

  • Identifier formats (receipt, order, invoice)
  • Quantity × price = net
  • Commission = 4% of net
  • Line total = net + commission + VAT
  • Sum of lines = printed total

Decision

All checks pass → accepted
Any check fails → referred with the reason

Targeted re-read

Only suspicious pages are read again with different image settings. Large bundles where most pages look suspicious are referred directly: that signals a new template.

Matching: shared invoices and duplicates

One invoice, several receipts

Invoice 5002602880
Receipt STO0000005251
Order PON0000000988 · p.21
Receipt STO0000005254
Order PON0000000989 · p.24

Matching is line by line (item, quantity, price). The invoice is counted once; ambiguous allocations are referred.

Duplicate receipts

  • Within a bundle: a receipt number that reappears after another receipt
  • Across bundles: in the competition check
  • The note shows both pages, and the verdict is held for the reviewer

What did not work, and what it taught me

🎛️ LoRA fine-tuning (600 pages)

Small gain: 85/121 items vs 81/121. The problem was columns and image quality, not lack of training.

🔁 Two reads agreeing

20–28% of agreed rows were still wrong: the same model repeats the same mistake.

🖨️ Low-resolution scans (~100 dpi)

No automatic acceptance, but still zero errors passed.

🆕 Unseen template (49 pages)

0 accepted, 15/15 referred. Safety held; automation needs tuning on the new template.

Design science in action: the final test round

Before

A receipt page repeated inside one bundle was merged with the original. Items doubled (19,360 vs 9,680) and the report showed a misleading arithmetic error.

➜

After

The second copy is recorded separately: “Duplicate receipt within the bundle” with both pages, and the verdict is held for the reviewer.

Rules engine untouchedRe-read rule limited to bundles ≥ 10 pages12/12 regression tests passAll tests re-run

Limitations, responsibility and next steps

⚠️ Limitations

  • Measured on synthetic data
  • Outputs are review drafts
  • “Arithmetically closed” ≠ money paid

🛡️ Responsible AI

  • Runs on-premises, documents stay inside
  • Human decides, every decision is signed
  • Aligned with SDAIA AI ethics principles

🚀 Next steps

  • Labeled field documents
  • Tune the reader on new templates
  • Timing study with auditors
